outreach_draft.subject: A thought on Kelley Law Firm’s business-litigation work
outreach_draft.body:
Kevin,

I noticed Kelley Law Firm’s public site is built very strongly around personal injury, while your own firm profile also says the practice handles business litigation and that you represent small businesses in commercial disputes. That business client is arriving with a completely different set of questions from an injury client—contracts, financial exposure, disputes, strategy, and whether litigation can be avoided or needs to be pursued.

A focused Business Litigation page could:
- give that business owner a clearer path into the firm
- give Google a focused page to crawl and index
- give AI tools clearer context around that side of the practice

You already have the credibility and positioning in your profile, so I’m using Business Litigation as the first mockup example.

I’m putting together a quick mockup to show you what I mean. I’ll send it over in the next couple of days.

If you’d rather I didn’t, just let me know.
